title: Intramuscular Injection in Adult Mice
author: Allen Institute for Brain Science
materials: Intramuscular Injection in an Adult Mouse
Injectable substance, as described in approved IACUC protocol
Warning: Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) should be used at all times while operating this protocol. If you are unsure what PPE you should be using, see your immediate supervisor.
Return injectable reagent to appropriate storage location.

steps.title: Verify animal identity
steps.instruction: Retrieve the mouse from its designated location, confirming that the cage card number and LabTracks ID match the LabTracks task; then double‑check cage number, LabTracks ID, ear notches, sex, and tattoos also match the task.

steps.title: Confirm weight and dose
steps.instruction: Weigh the animal or confirm its previously recorded weight on the cage card, consult the dosing chart from the Standard of Care Protocol, and verify that the calculated dose is appropriate for the animal’s weight.

steps.title: Prepare syringe and drug
steps.instruction: Using an insulin syringe (0.3 mL or 1.0 mL depending on injection volume), wipe the top of any bottle with a rubber stopper with an alcohol wipe, then fill the syringe with the specified injectable compound plus a small excess; invert and flick gently to remove bubbles, and expel any extra solution until the exact dosing volume is achieved.

steps.title: Cap syringes for transport
steps.instruction: When transporting syringes, cap the needles using a recapper.

steps.title: Position mouse for injection
steps.instruction: Place the mouse on a surface where it can gain traction, grab it at the base of the tail, and isolate the hind leg by either elongating the animal or elevating the hind quarters, allowing the front legs to hold onto the surface; alternatively, the mouse may be scruffed during dosing to prevent tissue damage.

steps.title: Inject intramuscularly
steps.instruction: Insert the needle into the hamstring (or an alternative thigh, tibialis anterior, rectus femoris, or gluteus) muscle to a depth of approximately 2–3 mm, then inject the dose with moderate pressure and speed; remove the syringe/needle after injection.

steps.title: Return mouse to cage
steps.instruction: Place the mouse back into its cage.

steps.title: Record injection details
steps.instruction: On the cage card and LabTracks task, record the substance, route, volume, date, time, and your initials; also verify that the lot number of the substance is identified and recorded.

steps.title: Return cage and verify equipment
steps.instruction: Return the cage to its originating rack and check that the QD is functioning properly.

steps.title: Repeat for all animals
steps.instruction: Continue the above steps until all animals requiring dosing have been completed.

steps.title: Clean work area
steps.instruction: Clean the work area where injections were performed with an approved disinfectant.

steps.title: Dispose of sharps
steps.instruction: Dispose of the syringe/needle in an approved biohazard sharps container without recapping the needle, ensuring the container is not filled more than two‑thirds full.

steps.title: Retain unused material
steps.instruction: Retain all expired or unused material for disposal by Stericycle or another authorized reverse distributor.
